PCE SUPPORTS FED HOLD FOR NOW

Capital Economics says July’s core PCE increase is unlikely to trigger a Fed rate hike in September.

However, with annual core inflation at 3.3% and economic growth remaining resilient, the firm believes higher rates may eventually be necessary.

HORMUZ REOPENING ODDS JUMP

Kalshi traders see rising odds that Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal:

Before Apr. 1, 2027: 50%
Before Jul. 1, 2027: 54%
Before Jan. 1, 2028: 68%

The jump follows Iran’s claim of a revenue-sharing deal with Oman.
